processes.exact_task: Prove or refute the actual rank-four adjoint suffix target (delta_4)_+<=U_3(U_2(a-1)-1), or the rank-three target (delta_3)_+<=U_2(a-1), for every V>=125.
processes.method: Reuse each exact compressed orbit once, isolate only adjacent carry walls, then seek a complete symbolic wall classification rather than extrapolating a cutoff.
processes.success_gate: An all-parameter proof of a rank-three/rank-four target, an actual counterexample that closes it, or a finite complete wall taxonomy with proved coverage.
processes.stop_rule: Freeze every fixed-rank suffix-budget subroute if rank three and rank four both have actual counterexamples, or if the proposed taxonomy requires an unbounded state equivalent to LTJ. Larger ordinary scans are non-success.

processes.exact_task: Determine whether M786G-13 has an explicit noncircular rule selecting residual transversals T_k for B_Q={1} union QN with a first executable prefix-Carleson kill test.
processes.success_gate: One explicit T_k selection rule, a precise all-parameter claimed recourse estimate, and an executable first falsifier justify a successor campaign.
processes.stop_rule: Do not initialize a successor if the only premise is existence of o(2^k) transversals, an optimum choice, nestedness, or a pre-existing infinite transversal; record admission failure instead.

erdos_776.result: No rank-three, rank-four, or LTJ failure occurred in the finite 125<=V<=2000 falsifier. The minimum observed rank-three and rank-four margins were 64 and 73.
erdos_776.exact_negative: A fixed positive canonical common-prefix proof is refuted by the actual rank-three wall V=300->301; the finite screen also contains a rank-four zero-prefix wall.
erdos_776.decision: No promotion. Keep the campaign at survivor_deepening but pause ordinary scans until a materially new all-parameter plateau-position or joint multirank invariant is supplied.

erdos_786_distinct.result: M786G-13 has an explicit periodic baseline but no explicit noncircular selector for T_k, no proved rate, and therefore no executable first recourse kill test.
erdos_786_distinct.decision: Do not initialize a successor campaign. CR.1 remains a valid conditional theorem; M786G-13 and the public problem remain open.

round_checkpoint.portfolio_decision: Neither problem earns another immediate compute round. Retain #776 only as a paused symbolic survivor and #786 M13 only as a conditional watchlist mechanism.
